subject.title: Text between tool calls leaks to messaging channels

question: Should direct/source messaging turns continue to auto-deliver bare assistant text by default, or should user-visible channel output require final-only or message-tool-only semantics with an upgrade path?
rationale: Current main contains partial technical fixes, but the remaining complete fix changes default channel-delivery semantics and can affect existing users who rely on bare-text direct replies.

options.title: Adopt explicit/final delivery with migration
options.body: Make channel-visible output require final-only or message-tool delivery by default where feasible, preserving compatibility through documented config, doctor guidance, or a staged rollout.

options.title: Land opt-in mitigations only
options.body: Keep automatic direct replies as the default and land narrow opt-in guards such as final-tag enforcement or NO_REPLY buffering for affected operators.

options.title: Keep automatic direct replies
options.body: Treat leak prevention as provider/channel-specific hardening while preserving current automatic bare-text reply behavior for direct chats.

recommendation.title: Adopt explicit/final delivery with migration
recommendation.body: Make channel-visible output require final-only or message-tool delivery by default where feasible, preserving compatibility through documented config, doctor guidance, or a staged rollout.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored recent merged phase-aware leak fixes across the same assistant text and visible-delivery surfaces.
